Economic Moat Rating (Primary Label)
Size-agnostic · ROIC & pricing durability
Wide Moat Dominant structural advantage sustaining excess returns for 20+ years (mega & niche monopolies) Narrow Moat Durable competitive advantage sustaining excess returns for 10+ years Weak Moat Fragile advantage vulnerable to price wars or disruption No Moat Commoditized price-taker with zero structural barriers to entry
Multibagger Return Attribution
10-year empirical drivers from the Alta Fox 104-stock study & Mayer compounding laws.
Empirical 10-Year Return Engines
~54%
Revenue Growth
Organic volume & pricing scale (+19.8%/yr median).
~27%
Margin Expansion
Fixed-cost absorption (10.5% → 26.8% EBITDA).
~19%
Multiple Re-Rating
Valuation multiple re-rating from unloved troughs.
Compounding Velocity (Buffett-Mayer Law) ROIC × Reinvestment Rate
Over 10 years, shareholder returns mathematically converge to return on capital. A 25% ROIC firm reinvesting 70% of cash flow compounds intrinsic value at 17.5% / yr without multiple expansion.
Gross Margin >50% Pricing power shield to absorb inflation and sustain organic R&D/CapEx advantage.
Skin in Game >15% Founder leadership or high insider ownership aligning capital allocation with per-share value.
